title.en: Peach Blossom Spring, with its Poem

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource, including the poem that follows the account; textual notes are omitted, and the poem is set four lines to a paragraph.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，收入记后之诗；不录校记，诗每四句为一段。

basis.en: Eastern Jin prose and verse; the author died in 427.
basis.zh: 东晋诗文，作者卒于 427 年。

note.en: Tao Yuanming’s account of a fisherman who finds a hidden valley whose people have lived apart since the Qin, followed by the poem it was written to introduce. It gave Chinese its phrase for a good place beyond reach. Notice that no one can find the way back, and that the story closes on a quiet line: after that no one asked the way to the ford.
note.zh: 陶渊明记一个渔人误入隐秘的山谷，那里的人自秦时避乱以来与世隔绝；后附它原本要引出的那首诗。中文里“世外桃源”一说由此而来。留意没有人找得到回去的路，故事以一句平静的话收尾：后遂无问津者。

excerpt.orig: 林盡水源，便得一山，山有小口，髣髴若有光。
excerpt.en: Where the grove ended, at the source of the stream, he found a hill, and in the hill a small opening from which there seemed to come a glimmer of light.
excerpt.zh: 林尽水源，便得一山，山有小口，仿佛若有光。

gloss.en: The Taiyuan reign (376–396) of Emperor Xiaowu of the Eastern Jin.
gloss.zh: 东晋孝武帝的年号（376—396）。

gloss.en: Wuling commandery, around today’s Changde in Hunan.
gloss.zh: 郡名，治所在今湖南常德一带。

gloss.en: 緣 means along: he followed the stream.
gloss.zh: 缘，沿着。沿着溪水前行。

gloss.en: 英 is a flower: fallen petals lay thick and bright.
gloss.zh: 英，花。落花繁多交杂。

gloss.en: An old spelling of 仿佛: dimly, as if.
gloss.zh: 同“仿佛”，隐隐约约，好像。

gloss.en: In neat, orderly rows.
gloss.zh: 整齐的样子。

gloss.en: Paths between the fields, running north to south (阡) and east to west (陌).
gloss.zh: 田间小路，南北向为阡，东西向为陌。

gloss.en: Yellowed hair and hanging tufts: the old and the very young.
gloss.zh: 黄发，老人头发由白转黄，指老人；垂髫，孩童垂下的短发，指孩子。

gloss.en: 要 is read as 邀, to invite.
gloss.zh: 要，通“邀”，邀请。

gloss.en: Their ancestors fled the troubles of the Qin, which fell in 207 BCE, nearly six hundred years before the Taiyuan era.
gloss.zh: 祖先躲避秦朝时的战乱。秦亡于公元前 207 年，距太元年间将近六百年。

gloss.en: A place cut off from the world.
gloss.zh: 与世隔绝的地方。

gloss.en: Let alone the Wei (220–265) and the Jin, the dynasties that followed the Han.
gloss.zh: 更不必说魏（220—265）和晋了。无论，不要说。

gloss.en: 不足 is ‘not worth’, 道 is ‘to tell’: it is not worth telling to people outside.
gloss.zh: 不值得对外面的人说。不足，不值得；道，说。

gloss.en: 扶 means along, 向 means earlier: he went back along the way he had come.
gloss.zh: 扶，沿着；向，先前的。沿着来时的路回去。

gloss.en: To mark the way.
gloss.zh: 做记号。

gloss.en: 詣 is to call on a superior; the 太守 was the governor of the commandery.
gloss.zh: 诣，拜见；太守，郡的长官。

gloss.en: Liu Linzhi, courtesy name Ziji, a recluse of the Jin. The Jin history says he once went deep into the mountains gathering herbs, found a strange place, and could never find it again.
gloss.zh: 刘驎之，字子骥，东晋隐士。《晋书》说他曾入山采药，见到奇异之处，后来再去寻找，已不知所在。

gloss.en: To ask the way to the ford. The phrase comes from the Analects, where Confucius sends a disciple to ask two recluses the way.
gloss.zh: 津，渡口。问津，打听渡口，语出《论语·微子》孔子使子路问津于隐者。后泛指探问、寻访。

gloss.en: The house of Ying, the ruling family of the Qin.
gloss.zh: 秦王族姓嬴，指秦朝统治者。

gloss.en: Xia Huanggong and Qi Liji, two of the Four Greybeards who hid from the Qin on Mount Shang.
gloss.zh: 夏黄公和绮里季，是避秦隐居商山的“商山四皓”中的两位。

gloss.en: These people: the villagers’ ancestors.
gloss.zh: 这些人，指桃花源中人的祖先。

gloss.en: 靡 means none: no tax was paid to any king.
gloss.zh: 靡，没有。不用向君王缴税。

gloss.en: Ritual vessels for offerings of meat and grain; here, the rites themselves.
gloss.zh: 祭祀时盛放祭品的礼器，借指祭祀礼仪。

gloss.en: Calendars and almanacs that record the days.
gloss.zh: 记载岁时节令的历书。

gloss.en: Hidden for five hundred years: a round number for the centuries since the Qin.
gloss.zh: 隐藏了五百年，是从秦到晋的约数。

gloss.en: 淳 is the plain goodness of the village, 薄 the shallowness of the world outside; they spring from different sources.
gloss.zh: 淳，指桃花源的淳朴；薄，指世俗的浮薄。二者本源不同。

gloss.en: Those who wander within the bounds of the world, a phrase from the Zhuangzi.
gloss.zh: 在世俗之内奔走的人，语本《庄子》“游方之内”。

gloss.en: Those who share my mind; kindred spirits.
gloss.zh: 与我志趣相投的人。契，投合。

note.en: A plain, perfectly paced tale that gave Chinese its lasting image of a good place beyond reach; few short texts anywhere have shaped a culture’s imagination so deeply.
note.zh: 平实而节奏完美的叙述，留下“世外桃源”这一永恒意象；很少有短文如此深地塑造了一种文化的想象。
